customer: Caller from Aldora, a veteran selling his midsize SUV, said he can't find a paper title and asked what he needs to bring to the appointment.
agent: Customer asked about bringing a paper title to his sale appointment. Explained per 'States with electronic titles' that Aldora uses electronic titles, so the title is a record held by the state and there's no paper title to bring. Let him know we transfer the title electronically at the appointment, and if there was a loan, the lender releases the lien electronically as well. Customer was relieved and said he'd keep the appointment.
